changes.preflight: Use a shared operation.preflight phase for explicit options, Center-originated options and host/Center preflight. Admission remains a separate role-cancellation/rollback concept. Reserve before user reads, retain existing private snapshots and never reread author getters during application.
changes.readiness: Defer older readiness through the active preflight and pass it forward to an unfinished Center preparation. Coalesce target/entry replay signals rather than recursively draining the same absent target. Stamp deferred readiness with the actual focus application version. Accepted acquisition settles without default-option reprojection; rejected current attempts can coalesce one replacement replay. Newer intent, blur and original errors retain ownership.
changes.errors: Preserve the original request/preparation error over secondary deferred-readiness errors. Center.finish receives failure state only for this bounded request; scope activation/deactivation as a whole is not made transactional.
changes.shadow: One shared Web helper requires the target to remain connected and compares it with activeElement in its own Document/ShadowRoot. Four providers reuse it after native focus. No traversal of unrelated closed roots and no replacement of the requested target with a retargeted document host.
